import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int MAXN = 300; // safe size for n up to 12 (2*12*12+2=290)
    static final int MAXE = MAXN * MAXN;

    static class Dinic {
        class Edge {
            int to, rev, cap;
            Edge(int to, int rev, int cap) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.cap = cap;
            }
        }

        int n, src, dst;
        ArrayList<Edge>[] g;
        int[] level, it;

        void init(int n, int src, int dst) {
            this.n = n;
            this.src = src;
            this.dst = dst;
            g = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            level = new int[n];
            it = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(v, g[v].size(), cap);
            Edge b = new Edge(u, g[u].size(), 0);
            g[u].add(a);
            g[v].add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            level[src] = 0;
            q.add(src);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g[u]) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] < 0) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[dst] >= 0;
        }

        int dfs(int u, int f) {
            if (u == dst) return f;
            for (int i = it[u]; i < g[u].size(); i++) {
                it[u] = i;
                Edge e = g[u].get(i);
                if (e.cap > 0 && level[u] + 1 == level[e.to]) {
                    int ret = dfs(e.to, Math.min(f, e.cap));
                    if (ret > 0) {
                        e.cap -= ret;
                        g[e.to].get(e.rev).cap += ret;
                        return ret;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow() {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(it, 0);
                int f;
                while ((f = dfs(src, INF)) > 0) {
                    flow += f;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static int n, t, zx, zy;
    static char[][] smp, cmp, work;
    static int[][] vis;
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int X(int i, int j) { return i * n + j; }
    static int Y(int i, int j) { return n * n + i * n + j; }
    static int S() { return n * n * 2; }
    static int T() { return S() + 1; }
    static int N() { return T() + 1; }

    static class qNode {
        int x, y, t, type;
        qNode(int x, int y, int t, int type) {
            this.x = x; this.y = y; this.t = t; this.type = type;
        }
    }

    static void bfs(int sx, int sy) {
        Queue<qNode> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new qNode(sx, sy, 0, 0));
        vis[sx][sy] = 1;
        q.add(new qNode(zx, zy, 0, 1));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            qNode u = q.poll();
            int nx, ny;
            if (u.t == t) break;
            if (u.type == 0 && Character.isLetter(work[u.x][u.y])) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                nx = u.x + dx[i];
                ny = u.y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < n && ny >= 0 && ny < n) {
                    if (u.type == 0 && vis[nx][ny] == 0 && !Character.isLetter(work[nx][ny])) {
                        vis[nx][ny] = 1;
                        q.add(new qNode(nx, ny, u.t + 1, 0));
                    } else if (u.type == 1 && !Character.isLetter(work[nx][ny])) {
                        work[nx][ny] = 'Z';
                        q.add(new qNode(nx, ny, u.t + 1, 1));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextInt()) {
            n = sc.nextInt();
            t = sc.nextInt();
            smp = new char[n][n];
            cmp = new char[n][n];
            work = new char[n][n];
            vis = new int[n][n];
            Dinic dinic = new Dinic();
            dinic.init(N(), S(), T());
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                String line = sc.next();
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    smp[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                    if (Character.isDigit(smp[i][j]) && smp[i][j] > '0') {
                        dinic.addEdge(S(), X(i, j), smp[i][j] - '0');
                    } else if (smp[i][j] == 'Z') {
                        zx = i;
                        zy = j;
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                String line = sc.next();
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    cmp[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                    if (Character.isDigit(cmp[i][j]) && cmp[i][j] > '0') {
                        dinic.addEdge(Y(i, j), T(), cmp[i][j] - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                    if (!Character.isDigit(smp[i][j]) || smp[i][j] <= '0') continue;
                    for (int[] row : vis) Arrays.fill(row, 0);
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; x++) System.arraycopy(smp[x], 0, work[x], 0, n);
                    bfs(i, j);
                    for (int xi = 0; xi < n; xi++) {
                        for (int yi = 0; yi < n; yi++) {
                            if (!Character.isDigit(cmp[xi][yi]) || cmp[xi][yi] <= '0') continue;
                            if (vis[xi][yi] == 1) {
                                dinic.addEdge(X(i, j), Y(xi, yi), INF);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            System.out.println(dinic.maxFlow());
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
